correctness.rationale: Original model and normalization checked against Zhang--Li Equation (2). Exact planar algebra verified analytically and by rational coefficient checker. Positive simplex compact and invariant. For epsilon>=0, the exact equilibrium factorization eliminates all endemic equilibria; planar index/Poincare--Bendixson and negative one-sided center drift yield global extinction. Variation of constants for w=R-aI gives the uniform fast-variable exponential-plus-polynomial forcing estimate. The exact G derivative transforms the singularly scaled time, while the integrated exponential error is quadratic order in epsilon for a fixed interior seed, proving locally uniform crossover and both endpoint power-law constants. Finite test computations supplement, never replace, the proof. Domain excludes I0=0, epsilon<0, and non-invariant population totals.

value.rationale: The two equalities are the intrinsic reproduction-one and pitchfork-edge surfaces in the source model. At fixed R0=1 the disease-free decay changes singularly from inverse time to inverse-square-root time, with exact initial-condition-independent constants and a parameter-free crossover profile valid for every positive interior state. The inverse-square crossover-time scale quantifies physically relevant late clearance thresholds proportional to epsilon and is not a mere equilibrium or local normal-form coefficient. The value is specific to the model and bounded by its fixed-population/deterministic assumptions.
